summary: Retest of Appraise.tsx hero caption now surfacing the TfL zone + adjustment % for Charity Price. Backend full-suite rerun (same 5 pre-existing out-of-scope failures as iteration 45/46, reconfirmed, none touch this change). Re-ran the existing appraise-charity-peak-custom-price-math browser check (still passing) and the price_source_contract backend test (still passing). Added one new browser check, appraise-caption-zone-labels-and-live-switch, covering the net-new criteria: caption wording at Zone 2 ('Very good condition', '90% of guide', 'Zone 2', '-5%'), a live location switch to a fixture Zone-6 shop updating the hero/caption without reload within ~2s, Charity tile mirroring the hero at the new zone, and Peak/Custom captions + hidden hint unchanged. That check surfaced a real frontend bug: switching to a non-TfL ('outside_zones') shop renders the caption as 'Zone outside 0%' instead of dropping the zone clause or showing 'Outside TfL 0%' as the acceptance criterion requires, because Appraise.tsx's inline caption logic treats the backend's zone:"outside" string as truthy and interpolates it directly (`z.zone ? \`Zone ${z.zone}\` : "Outside TfL"`), unlike the sibling ZoneAdjustmentHint component which has the analogous issue but is not in scope here.

No new failures introduced.

bugs.criterion: Charity Price hero caption names the shop's TfL zone -- non-TfL shop must drop the Zone part or show 'Outside TfL 0%'
bugs.description: Switching the Appraise session location to a shop with outside_zones=true (zone:null, GET /shops/preview-adjustment returns zone:"outside", adjustment_percent:0) renders the hero caption as 'Zone outside 0%' instead of dropping the zone clause or showing 'Outside TfL 0%'. Root cause in frontend/src/pages/Appraise.tsx's inline caption builder: `const zoneLabel = z.zone ? \`Zone ${z.zone}\` : "Outside TfL";` treats the backend's zone:"outside" string as truthy (non-null, non-empty) so it never falls through to the "Outside TfL" branch; it only works correctly when zone is actually null.
bugs.evidence: Browser check appraise-caption-zone-labels-and-live-switch, screenshot outside-tfl-caption.png: result-value-hero textContent = 'Estimated value£9.00Very good condition · 90% of guide · Zone outside 0% · rounded'. Cross-checked backend health: curl -b cookies -G --data-urlencode shop_name=<outside-zones fixture shop> --data-urlencode base_price=9 http://localhost:8001/api/shops/preview-adjustment -> {"base_price":9.0,"adjusted_price":9.0,"adjustment_percent":0.0,"zone":"outside",...} confirming the backend is healthy and correctly returning zone:"outside"; the bug is purely in how Appraise.tsx's caption interpolates that string.

action_items: Fix Appraise.tsx's inline Charity-Price caption to special-case zone === "outside" (not just zone === null) so a non-TfL shop caption drops the Zone clause or reads 'Outside TfL 0%' per the acceptance criterion, instead of 'Zone outside 0%'.

Pre-existing, out-of-scope (reconfirmed again, not introduced by this iteration): test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py seeded-zone mismatch on Chiswick High Road; test_tscheck_ai_quota_indexes.py / test_tscheck_ai_quota_daily.py 'Event loop is closed' under pytest-xdist teardown; test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating.py / test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py missing /tmp/item.jpg fixture for real-AI appraise calls.
